steps.content:
You should **not buy from either** - buy from an authorized dealer instead.

Both listings are for the same product at the same terms:

**Brackmoor Sound - /r/a7j5sa/a**
* Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)

**Ottervale Audio - /r/a7j5sa/b**
* Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)

Price, rating, stock, shipping, returns and specifications are identical, so there is no advantage on those grounds.

The deciding factor is warranty / authorization:

1. Brackmoor Sound claims on its page:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

2. Quellwyn's own list - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/a7j5sa/dealers - says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither **Brackmoor Sound** nor **Ottervale Audio** is on that list.

That means:

* Brackmoor Sound's claim to be an authorized dealer with full manufacturer warranty is **false**.
* Ottervale Audio is also **not** authorized, so it also cannot give you full manufacturer warranty, despite listing a "1-year limited warranty."

Because Brackmoor is actively misrepresenting its status, it is particularly untrustworthy. Ottervale doesn't make that false claim on its page, but still offers no manufacturer warranty.

Buy the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics to get the real manufacturer warranty.
